conflicts.summary: Main already contains two question-key registries with disjoint keys. Pipeline extraction emits taxonomy.py keys. Curation approval and the trend catalog require a different key set. Canonical export copies the pipeline key through unchanged.

reproducible_example.export_path: pipeline/pdoom_pipeline/export/corpus.py copies statement question_key with no translation
reproducible_example.approval_rule: docs/CURATION.md requires the question key to be one of QUESTION_TAXONOMY

conflicts.requested_resolution: Agent 2 publishes one registry and an explicit mapping or replacement for pipeline keys. Agent 5 and Agent 3 consume that registry. Agent 7 will not invent a third taxonomy or silently retarget keys during integration.
conflicts.integration_rule: Do not merge extraction output into the product trend path until this mapping is explicit in the included commits.

migration_reservation.rule: The first workstream that adds a migration in an included commit claims the next integer. A later workstream rebases onto the next free number on the integration branch. Two files numbered 004 are a mechanical conflict Agent 7 may renumber, recording the original number, the new number, and the owner.
